name: CFACT

summary.text: The Committee for a Constructive Tomorrow (CFACT) was founded in 1985 by David Rothbard and Craig Rucker. DeSmog reports it received $582,000 from ExxonMobil (1998–2012) and $1.84 million from the Carthage and Sarah Scaife foundations since 1991, and, citing Greenpeace, over $4.1 million from Donors Trust and Donors Capital Fund between 2002 and 2011; the Energy and Policy Institute gives higher Donors Trust totals for 2008–2012.

openQuestions: All figures are from advocacy outlets reading 990s and foundation reports and disagree with each other (DeSmog's older report gives $542,000 Exxon / $1.28m Scaife to 2006); the owner should check ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer and the foundations' own grant databases before publishing amounts.
